verdict.rationale: Gecko presents itself as an "AI security engineer." Users can hand it specific tasks: clicking "Request fix" opens a patch PR, it can commit fixes directly to a PR branch, and it delivers PR security reviews and an AI-written repository wiki. These are fixed one-click actions, not a general assistant that accepts open-ended tasks, and the MCP server serves external AI tools rather than being a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant or chat interface for delegating arbitrary tasks, documentation of the scope of delegation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the delegated fix workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
